description: This file contains functions related to SOAP web services for SuiteCRM, including handling field data retrieval, session and access checks, relationship management, data formatting, and utility functions for encryption, file handling, and version comparison.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving bean instances.

classes.name: DBManagerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for database connection and query management.

classes.name: ACLController
classes.description: Controller class for access control list management.

classes.name: ACLAction
classes.description: Class for managing user actions and permissions.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of fields for a given SugarBean, including labels, types, and options.

methods.name: new_get_field_list
methods.description: Alternative method to retrieve module fields and link fields for a SugarBean.

methods.name: setFaultObject
methods.description: Sets a fault response in the SOAP server with an error object.

methods.name: checkSessionAndModuleAccess
methods.description: Validates session and module access permissions for a user.

methods.name: checkACLAccess
methods.description: Checks if a bean has access to a specific view type based on ACL.

methods.name: get_name_value
methods.description: Creates a name-value pair array.

methods.name: get_user_module_list
methods.description: Returns a list of modules accessible to a user.

methods.name: check_modules_access
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific access level to a module.

methods.name: get_name_value_list
methods.description: Generates a list of name-value pairs for a bean's fields.

methods.name: get_name_value_list_for_fields
methods.description: Generates name-value pairs for specified fields of a bean.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_list
methods.description: Converts an array to a list of name-value pairs.

methods.name: array_get_name_value_lists
methods.description: Converts an array to a list of name-value pairs, handling nested arrays.

methods.name: name_value_lists_get_array
methods.description: Converts a list of name-value pairs back to an associative array.

methods.name: array_get_return_value
methods.description: Creates a return array with id, module name, and name-value list.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_fields
methods.description: Generates a structured return value for a bean with specific fields.

methods.name: getRelationshipResults
methods.description: Retrieves related records for a bean via a relationship link.

methods.name: get_return_value_for_link_fields
methods.description: Generates linked record data for a bean.

methods.name: new_handle_set_relationship
methods.description: Creates relationships between modules.

methods.name: new_handle_set_entries
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple bean entries in a module.

methods.name: get_return_value
methods.description: Returns a structured array representing a bean's data.

methods.name: get_encoded_Value
methods.description: Encodes a value for XML output.

methods.name: get_name_value_xml
methods.description: Generates XML for a name-value list.

methods.name: new_get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Returns module fields and link fields for a bean.

methods.name: get_return_module_fields
methods.description: Returns module fields and an error list for a bean.

methods.name: get_return_error_value
methods.description: Creates an error value array.

methods.name: filter_field_list
methods.description: Filters a list of fields based on validity and access.

methods.name: filter_return_list
methods.description: Filters list data to include only selected fields.

methods.name: login_success
methods.description: Initializes language and string settings after login.

methods.name: add_create_account
methods.description: Creates or associates an account with a contact.

methods.name: check_for_duplicate_contacts
methods.description: Checks for duplicate contacts based on email and name.

methods.name: is_server_version_greater
methods.description: Compares client and server version arrays.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Extracts a file from a ZIP archive to a temporary directory.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the manifest.php file from a ZIP archive.

methods.name: get_encoded
methods.description: Serializes and base64 encodes an object.

methods.name: get_decoded
methods.description: Decodes and unserializes a base64 string.

methods.description: Decrypts a string using TripleDES if available.

methods.name: canViewPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is within a base directory.

methods.name: apply_values
methods.description: Applies data values to a SugarBean object, considering first sync.
